native_bridge.policy: The bridge is one generic ABI marshaller. New exact functions add registry data in semantic_native.cpp, not per-function bridge code.
native_bridge.fallback_policy: An unbound legacy entry continues through the processor implementation. This preserves behavior while a whole legacy object model is not yet ABI-safe to replace.
